QuestInfo.name: Utah's Request
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bUtah#k in #b#m271010400##k, near Henesys Ruins.
QuestInfo.1: Defeat the #bMutant Orange Mushroom#k and find the lost #bcrystal marble#k, which is precious to Utah.
QuestInfo.2: You found the marble and returned it to Utah. He should be able to go back to Camila now.

0.0: Still here? So you haven't told Camila yet, huh? ...Oh, you did. Good. Thanks.

yes.0: This is going to sound ridiculous... I'm looking for a marble. Camila gave it to for my birthday, back when we were kids.
yes.1: I think the #rMutant Orange Mushrooms#k picked it up... Or it stuck to one of their undersides. It's shiny and crystal. Think you can find it?

no.0: Guess you're busy. All right, I'll just keep on looking for it myself.

0.1: I have one more thing to ask of you. It's the reason I haven't gone back yet. Hear me out, will you?

1.0: Did you find the crystal marble?

yes.0: I thought I'd never find it. Those Orange Mushrooms aren't pushovers like they used to be. Thanks. I should go back and give the marble to Camila.

item.0: I think the #rMutant Orange Mushrooms#k took the #bshiny crystal marble#k. Please find it. It's very important to me.
